title: Baseline reproduction: published S0 numbers (D2 117/115, SP1n/SP3/SP6 4/7/20, L1 127, X1 2, X2 6, Y9b 3) and the #100 Lead control ABA_A 3/120 reproduced on the real pipeline
checkOnly-only Hosts keep S0 exactly (every flow=pre cell identical to S0 in denials, reach, denied and correlation issuances)
API_OVERUSE and custom API policies are untouched (every api/api_custom cell identical to S0)
Protection bound: on every attack/evasion/mixed cell (pre+out) the extra attacker verifications vs S0 are at most (correlation blocks issued by the arm) + max(0, 5 - S0 reach) + 1
Fairness non-regression: no benign, mixed or poisoning cell (pre+out, record-only) has more legitimate denials than S0
